wins.text: Services delivered a record quarter with revenues up 8% YoY; Security Services up 24% on new mandates; TTS up 4%; Services RoTCE of 26.4% for the quarter
Investment banking fees up 44% YoY driven by debt capital markets, advisory, and ECM; Banking revenues up 16% overall with positive operating leverage for the third consecutive quarter
Equities revenues up 32% driven by prime balances up ~22%, derivatives, and cash volume; Markets delivered net income of ~$1.1B
Wealth revenues up 9% with client investment assets growing 24% and end-of-period client balances up 14%; Wealth RoTCE improved to 8.5% from near-zero earlier in the year
Expenses down 2% YoY to $13.3B driven by organizational simplification and stranded cost reductions; positive operating leverage achieved across all 5 businesses

risks.text: Retail Services NCL rate expected to come in at the high end of the 5.75%-6.25% range for full year and likely higher in Q4; reserve-to-loan ratio elevated at ~11.7% for Retail Services portfolio
Amended consent order remains in place; data quality and regulatory reporting deficiencies cited as areas of delayed progress; Senator Warren publicly asked OCC to impose growth restrictions on Citi
NII ex-markets guided roughly flat sequentially in Q4 and slightly down for full year; headwinds from falling short-end rates on floating-rate assets and legacy franchise wind-downs
Banamex IPO timeline uncertain; Mexican judicial reform and deteriorating macro backdrop have pressured Mexican asset prices, with the largest Mexican bank trading at ~7x earnings
Full-year expenses expected at the higher end of $53.5B-$53.8B guidance range; year-to-date run rate implies ~$54B, creating a gap to the 2026 target of $51B-$53B

guidance_items.detail: Full-year 2024 revenue guidance of $80B-$81B reaffirmed; YTD at $61.6B, Q4 needed to close the gap is described as achievable
NII ex-markets for full year now expected to be 'slightly down' vs prior guidance of 'modestly down'; Q4 NII ex-markets expected roughly flat sequentially — a modest improvement vs prior expectations
Full-year expenses expected at the higher end of $53.5B-$53.8B range, excluding FDIC special assessment and civil money penalty; 2026 target of $51B-$53B reaffirmed
Branded Cards NCL range of 3.5%-4% for full year reaffirmed; Retail Services NCL expected at high end of 5.75%-6.25% range
Medium-term RoTCE target of 11%-12% and revenue CAGR of 4%-5% reaffirmed; USPB targeted for high-teens RoTCE over medium term

analyst_concerns_not_in_prepared: Potential asset cap or additional regulatory actions beyond the amended consent order (Senator Warren's OCC letter)
Banamex IPO timeline risk given Mexican judicial reform and deteriorating Mexican asset prices
DTA deductions as a headwind to capital accretion and path to utilization
